study.comparator: intensified insulin (short acting insulin three times daily plus glargine and metformin)
study.notes: STUDY: open label randomised intervention trial (Thessaloniki, second part of a two part study) in insulin treated type 2 diabetes with normal aminotransferases: exenatide 5 ug twice daily for 4 weeks then 10 ug twice daily (dose_mg 0.01 per injection) added to glargine and metformin (group B) vs intensified insulin, short acting insulin three times daily plus glargine and metformin (group C), after a 5 week run in; 110 randomised, allocation by the patients name initials, 7 dropped out all from group C, 55 and 48 analysed (Table 2 n); 6 months (26 weeks entered; median treatment duration 6.7 and 6.65 months); Table 2 gives baseline and final mean plus or minus SD per arm for HbA1c, lipids and adiponectin (route arm_change_imputed_r, correlation 0.5) and deltas as medians with IQR (not used); weight, ALT, AST and CRP are medians or deltas only for the markers; the adiponectin change is the stated aim of the intervention part (prespecified TRUE on that row, FALSE for the others); pct_weight_change from the Table 2 means in the exenatide arm, 84.6 to 82.4 kg, minus 2.2 kg equals minus 2.6 percent (insulin arm 90.4 to 91.7 kg, plus 1.4 percent; Table 2 delta medians minus 2.0 vs plus 3.5 kg, between group p below 0.001); no funding source, no conflicts declared (industry_funded FALSE); rob_overall high

rows.notes: Table 2: HbA1c percent baseline and final per arm; delta medians minus 0.8 vs minus 1.0, between group p 0.690
Table 2: total cholesterol mmol/L baseline and final per arm; delta medians 0.2 vs 0.6, between group p below 0.001
Table 2: LDL mmol/L baseline and final per arm; delta medians 0 vs 0.2, between group p 0.085
Table 2: triglycerides mmol/L baseline and final per arm; delta medians 0 vs 0.4, between group p 0.004
Table 2: adiponectin ug/mL by ELISA baseline and final per arm; delta medians 1.5 vs 1.1 ug/mL (24.2 vs 23.6 percent), between group p 0.965

json.design: open label randomised intervention trial, exenatide twice daily added to glargine and metformin vs intensified insulin, insulin treated type 2 diabetes with normal aminotransferases, 110 randomised by name initials, 55 and 48 analysed, 6 months
json.reason: full text group (institutional route); five inventory markers with baseline and final mean and SD per arm in Table 2 by the imputed change route; CRP, ALT and AST are medians with IQR only
biomarkers_reported_no_variance: hsCRP (CRP printed in mg/dL, Table 2 medians with IQR only: exenatide 3.3 to 1.3, insulin 1.7 to 1.1; delta medians 0 vs minus 0.5, between group p 0.001)
ALT (Table 2 medians with IQR only: 18 to 17 vs 24.5 to 25.5 U/L)
AST (Table 2 medians with IQR only: 16 to 20 vs 21 to 23.5 U/L)
other_markers: weight, BMI, waist and hip circumference, WHR
liver biopsy findings in the separate NAFLD cohort (group A, not randomised)

rob.justification: allocation by the patients name initials, not a random sequence and not concealed, with heavier patients in the insulin arm at baseline (D1 high); open label with self titrated prandial insulin in the comparator (D2 some concerns); 7 of 110 dropped out, all from the insulin arm, completers analysed (D3 some concerns); laboratory assays (D4 low); no registration or protocol cited, outcomes listed in the aims (D5 some concerns)

doubts: CRP is printed in mg/dL with values typical of mg/L; recorded as printed and not entered
the between group p values of Table 2 compare delta medians by Mann Whitney and are not used; the imputed change route rests on a correlation of 0.5
the intensified insulin comparator gained weight, so the lipid and adiponectin contrasts are net of opposite weight trajectories
